class.name: NetwInterestAwareness
class.brief_description: One awareness edge the server owes a peer: a route seen or unseen through a layer, or one peer starting or stopping observing it.
class.description: The two are separate kinds rather than one with a flag, because a layer edge names nobody in particular while an observer edge names exactly one peer. That difference is the whole reason a layer edge carries [code]observer_peer == 0[/code] and an observer edge carries a non-zero one, and [method from_array] refuses either mistake. [method from_array] is the only reader of the wire form. It answers [code]null[/code] for anything this class could not have produced, and says nothing about it: the row arrived from a peer, so a malformed one is something that peer can send at will, and a log line per arrival is a channel that peer would then own. [codeblock] [type, route, layer_id, observer_peer, kind] the wire row, in order type 0 layer edge, 1 observer edge route positive; a route this peer holds layer_id non-empty observer_peer 0 for a layer edge, the observer for an observer edge kind 0 exit, 1 enter [/codeblock]

method.name: from_array
method.description: Reads one wire row, or answers [code]null[/code]. Every field is checked for type and for range, and the type-to-observer pairing above is checked as one rule rather than two, so neither half can be satisfied alone.

method.name: get_kind
method.description: [code]0[/code] for an exit, [code]1[/code] for an enter. The ordinals of the published [code]InterestCore.Kind[/code], which stays the one spelling.

method.name: get_layer_id
method.description: The layer this edge is attributed to.

method.name: get_observer_peer
method.description: The observing peer for an observer edge, and [code]0[/code] for a layer edge.

method.name: get_route
method.description: The route the edge is about. A route rather than an entity, because the receiving peer knows the entity only once its route is live.

method.name: layer_edge
method.description: An edge saying [param route] moved in or out of [param layer_id]. Answers [code]null[/code] under the same refusals as [method from_array].

method.name: observer_edge
method.description: An edge saying [param observer_peer] began or ceased to see [param route] through [param layer_id]. A zero [param observer_peer] is refused, because that is what a layer edge means.

method.name: to_array
method.description: The wire row, in the order the codeblock above gives.

constants.constant: An edge about the route itself: it moved in or out of a layer.
An edge about one peer: it began or ceased to see the route through a layer.
